description:
Raw per-store search results for a product name at all five
    supermarkets: every matching line at each store, including other pack
    sizes, without matching the same product across stores. Returns a dict
    keyed by store, with up to `limit_per_store` matching products per store.

    Args:
        query: product-name substring (e.g. "heinz baked beans 415g").
        limit_per_store: how many matches per store (default 5).
name: compare_price_across_stores
title: Compare a product across supermarkets
